result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I compiled the `codeanalyzer` module and it builds cleanly, but I didn't run any tests and didn't add one for this change.

The change is one extra condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeContributorsAggregator.java`. A contributor who matches no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped.

Two cases needed no code. A blank latest-commit date already counts as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for a blank date. Configured teams go through `addToTeams`, which I didn't touch, so they keep all their members.
